    Contact Lenses in Baton Rouge, Louisiana

    We believe that finding the perfect contact lenses should be a seamless and personalized experience. Whether you’re exploring contacts for the first time or seeking the ideal pair to match your active lifestyle, we’re dedicated to providing you with a wide array of options that cater to your specific vision needs and preferences.

    Schedule Appointment (225) 752-2419
    Schedule an Appointment

    Visit us For a Simple and Easy Contact Lens Fitting

    Fitting lenses to your lifestyle: We will determine the best fitting lens based on your lifestyle needs and the shape and health of your eye. In most cases, you’ll have the opportunity to try lenses on the same day as your exam. You can even go home with a few samples before making a final decision.

    Follow up fittings: We follow up the initial fitting and then make any necessary changes in fit or materials to get you the best possible fit. We teach all our patients proper contact lens care and also possible consequences if proper care is not taken. Then we continue with long-term follow-up to monitor the condition of the lenses and to ensure that proper hygiene is being maintained.

    Eye Exams For Contact Lenses

    Our targeted eye exams for contact lenses ensure you get the right prescription, whether you're new to contacts or need an update. We focus on finding the perfect balance between clear vision and comfort. For newcomers, we determine the best lens type and fit for your lifestyle. For seasoned wearers, we update your prescription and check eye health to maintain optimal comfort and clarity. Trust us for a seamless journey to sharp, comfortable vision.

    Contact Lenses for the "Hard-to-Fit" Patient

    Challenges such as astigmatism, presbyopia, keratoconus and dry eyes needn’t be a barrier to contact lens wear, but they do require more time and patience.

    Hard-To-Fit-Contacts

    Disposable Contacts

    Experience ultimate comfort and convenience with modern disposable lenses. Whether you prefer the simplicity of daily disposables—which offer a fresh, sterile pair every morning with no cleaning required—or the value of bi-weekly and monthly lenses, we have options to fit your lifestyle.

    • Daily Disposables: Ideal for sensitive eyes, allergies, and busy schedules.
    • Monthly & Bi-Weekly: A durable, cost-effective choice for consistent wear.
    • Specialty Options: Available in various tints, colors, and multifocal designs for presbyopia.

    Our doctors will help you determine the best replacement schedule to ensure your eyes stay healthy and your vision remains crisp.

    Bifocal and Multifocal Contact Lenses

    If you find yourself holding reading materials at arm’s length, you may be experiencing presbyopia—a natural, age-related change in vision. Multifocal contact lenses offer a convenient alternative to reading glasses, allowing you to see clearly at all distances without compromising your lifestyle.

    • Bifocal Lenses: Feature two distinct powers for near and distance vision.
    • Multifocal Lenses: Provide a range of powers (similar to progressive eyeglass lenses) for a seamless transition between near, intermediate, and far vision.
    • Monovision: An alternative technique where one eye is corrected for distance and the other for near vision.

    Available in both soft and gas-permeable materials, these lenses give you the freedom to look in any direction—up, down, or side-to-side—with consistent clarity.

    Gas Permeable (GP) Contact Lenses

    Gas Permeable (GP) lenses are rigid lenses that offer a durable alternative to soft contacts. Because they are made of a firm, oxygen-permeable material, they provide incredibly sharp vision and allow your eyes to "breathe" better, promoting long-term ocular health.

    • Superior Clarity: The rigid surface maintains its shape, providing more stable and crisp vision than many soft lenses.
    • Durability: With proper care, a single pair of GP lenses can last a year or more, making them a cost-effective long-term solution.
    • Custom Fit: Every lens is custom-made to match the exact curvature and size of your eye for maximum precision.
    • Ideal for Astigmatism: Often the best choice for patients with high astigmatism who struggle with soft lens stability.

    While they require a brief adaptation period, many patients find that the health benefits and vision quality of GP lenses are well worth the switch.
